12.    RESOLUTION Expressing the support of the Governing Body for the submission of a
                      —




       petition by the Governing Body to the Downtown Development Authority for inclusion of
       property in the Downtown Development District. (SPONSORS MR. LAYBOURN. MR.
                                                                   —




       ROYBAL. MR. SEGRAVE AND MR. WHITE)

Dr. Rinne moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Charles Bloom, Planning & Development Director, provided a staff report and Chairman Roybal
commented on the item. Public comment was made by Stephen Fotiades.

There being no further items for the agenda to come before the Public Services Committee, the
meeting was adjourned at 12:15 p.m.
